error_codes.ui_binding_duplicate: two form fields bind the same TaskRequest path
error_codes.ui_binding_missing: a form field carries no TaskRequest binding
error_codes.ui_binding_type_mismatch: the field type disagrees with its binding
error_codes.ui_binding_unknown: the form field names an unknown TaskRequest binding
error_codes.ui_form_descriptor_mismatch: the form is pinned to a different descriptor digest
error_codes.ui_form_digest_mismatch: the form body does not match its declared digest
error_codes.ui_form_malformed: the form document is not a valid acp2.ui.form.v1 object
error_codes.ui_form_unknown_major: the form declares an unknown acp2.ui.form major
error_codes.ui_form_unreadable: the installed distribution's form document is unreadable
error_codes.ui_format_unknown: the form declares an unknown format
error_codes.ui_keyword_rejected: the form uses a keyword outside the frozen subset
error_codes.ui_keyword_unknown: the form uses a keyword the platform does not know
error_codes.ui_required_undeclared: required names a property the form does not declare
error_codes.ui_subset_drift: the served subset tables differ from the frozen ones
error_codes.ui_subset_unknown_major: the form declares an unknown acp2.ui-subset major
error_codes.ui_unit_mismatch: the field unit disagrees with its binding

keywords.format: one of the frozen format names
keywords.properties: object of property name -> form schema node
keywords.title: plain text annotation (never markup)
keywords.type: string|array of the frozen type names

profile_note: This profile governs the executable subset of a capability FORM schema that a browser may evaluate. The C-track ui_dialect block in experience/{proposal,research-record,view-model,manifest-extension}.schema.json names the wider, server-side response-document vocabulary; it never authorises a browser to evaluate $ref or a combinator in a form. No open JSON Schema 2020-12 evaluator is implemented (release SCOPE-OUT-02).
registration: Not registered in docs/reference/next-change/acp2-contracts/manifest.json: M3-06 adds the capability-form contract as a platform-owned UI document; the runtime authority is src/acp/api/capability_forms.py (an installed wheel cannot read docs/) and tests/test_acp2_ui_subset.py pins the digests and the byte-for-byte table parity.
